description: The Redis memory store's layout (design/45-Long-Term-Memory.md, "Redis"), written by both engines: what a store with prefix `strata`, 4 dimensions and the default (FLAT) index leaves after upserting `record` (memory/record.sample.json without its timestamps) at its `updated_at`, when the record was first created at its `created_at`. Keys are relative to the prefix plus ':'. A key part (namespace, tenant, id) is escaped as `%` to `%25` and `:` to `%3A`, in that order, so ':' only ever separates parts. A tag is 'x' followed by the lowercase hex of the value's UTF-8 bytes, so a tag needs no escaping in a query, is never empty and can't contain the TAG separator ','. `_scope` is tag(namespace) + tag(tenant) + tag(model), `_id` is tag(id), `_meta` holds one tag(key) + tag(value) per metadata pair, keys in byte order, joined by ',' (absent when there is no metadata). `embedding` is the vector as little-endian float32 bytes (given here as hex). `content` (absent when null) and `metadata` (`{}` when empty) are JSON text, compared as JSON; `text` is absent when null. Timestamps are RFC 3339 UTC at whole seconds. The two sorted sets score as the checkpoint store's index does (design/19): the updated_at text's digits. `ids:<ns>:<tenant>` holds each id of a scope at score 0, so a listing reads it by ZRANGEBYLEX in byte order; `updated` holds each record's full key, so a purge reads it oldest first. `schema` is a hash with the `memory` component's version and the store's dimensions. `ft_create` is the index's FT.CREATE arguments after the command name; `ft_create_hnsw` the vector field's arguments with `MemoryIndex` HNSW (m 16, ef_construction 64).
